events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Rock Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost a true showman. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-one years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: On this day in 1980, the world lost John Lennon. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message of peace continue to resonate today.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80 today.

angles.name: Starman's Legacy
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of a true musical pioneer. David Bowie's influence is still out of this world.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, on what would have been his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. His music lives on.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Eighty-three years young for the guitar maestro, Jimmy Page. What's your favourite riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Sir Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Distinctive Voice
angles.copy: Eighty-two years of that unmistakable voice. Happy Birthday, Rod Stewart!

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: Madness Legend
angles.copy: Sixty-six today for the one and only Suggs! What's your top Madness track?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 71st birthday to the voice behind hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', Paul Young.

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Seventy-one today for the smooth vocals of Paul Young. Still keeping us dancing!

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Happy 81st birthday to the legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Country Queen
angles.copy: Eighty-one and still shining bright. Happy Birthday to the incredible Dolly Parton!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Pop Royalty
angles.copy: Fifty-six today for the Take That frontman. What's your favourite Gary Barlow moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Happy 77th birthday to the Trinidadian-British soul and R&B singer, Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Seventy-seven today for the smooth sounds of Billy Ocean. Get out of our dreams and into our cars!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony took place on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago, rock royalty was officially enshrined. Who was in that first class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Fifty-five today for the ever-youthful Mark Owen. Still got that boyband charm!

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Rooftop Magic
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles made history on a London rooftop. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary drummer and singer, Phil Collins.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Seventy-six today for the drumming and vocal powerhouse, Phil Collins. Still 'In The Air Tonight' for us!

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to British actor Hugh Grant.

angles.name: British Charm
angles.copy: Sixty-seven today for one of Britain's most charming exports. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented pop superstar, Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Pop Prince
angles.copy: Forty-six today for the Prince of Pop! From boyband to solo sensation, JT still brings the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the beloved British actor, Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Only Fools And Horses
angles.copy: Eighty-seven today for a true national treasure. What's your favourite Sir David Jason character? Lovely jubbly!

events.title: The Day The Music Died
events.blurb: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper who tragically died in a plane crash on this day in 1959.

angles.name: A Tragic Loss
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago, music lost three stars. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Happy 61st birthday to the 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer, Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up
angles.copy: Sixty-one today for Rick Astley! We're never gonna give him up, never gonna let him down.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of the reggae icon, Bob Marley, who would have turned 82 today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Eighty-two years since the birth of a legend. Bob Marley's message of 'One Love' still resonates globally.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter Carole King.

angles.name: Timeless Tapestry
angles.copy: Eighty-five today for the incredible Carole King. Her songs are the soundtrack to so many lives.

events.title: Whitney Houston tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the unparalleled voice of Whitney Houston on the anniversary of her passing in 2012. She would have been 64.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost one of the greatest voices of all time. Remembering Whitney Houston.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, Take That announced their split, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Pop Heartbreak
angles.copy: Twenty-one years ago, the news broke. Take That announced their split and pop music was never quite the same... until the reunion!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine
angles.copy: Sixty-eight today for Ali Campbell! What's your favourite UB40 singalong?

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to global superstar Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Chart Topper
angles.copy: Thirty-six today for the man with the acoustic guitar and endless hits, Ed Sheeran!

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of The Quiet Beatle, George Harrison, who would have turned 84 today.

angles.name: My Sweet Lord
angles.copy: Eighty-four years since the birth of George Harrison. His spiritual contributions to music are truly timeless.
